video.title: LabeledContent, GroupBox & ControlGroup | Day 173
video.description:
Learn to explain how to group and label content in SwiftUI settings screens: LabeledContent, GroupBox & ControlGroup, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
LabeledContent - A view that shows a label on one side and a value on the other.
GroupBox - A container that puts related content in a box with a title.
ControlGroup - A container that joins related controls, such as buttons, into one set.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI LabeledContent, GroupBox & ControlGroup | Day 173
landscape.description:
Explain LabeledContent, GroupBox & ControlGroup in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
레이블드콘텐츠, 그룹박스, 컨트롤그룹 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

LabeledContent - A view that shows a label on one side and a value on the other.
한국어: 레이블드콘텐츠: 한쪽에 이름, 다른 쪽에 값을 보여 주는 뷰

GroupBox - A container that puts related content in a box with a title.
한국어: 그룹박스: 관련된 내용을 제목이 있는 박스에 담는 컨테이너

ControlGroup - A container that joins related controls, such as buttons, into one set.
한국어: 컨트롤그룹: 버튼처럼 관련된 컨트롤을 하나의 세트로 묶는 컨테이너

In this video, Mina and Jake clean up a settings screen with rows, boxes and button groups, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain LabeledContent, GroupBox and ControlGroup in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my settings screen looks messy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us clean it up. Start with the version row.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used two Text views in an HStack.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use LabeledContent. It shows the label and the value, and it matches the system style.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is much shorter. Does LabeledContent work in a Form too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it fits well in a list or a Form.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put them in a GroupBox. It adds a box and a title, like in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the GroupBox keeps related details together?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And I have undo and redo buttons. Is a ControlGroup right for them?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The ControlGroup shows them as one related set.
Use LabeledContent for a name and value row.
